messages:
Anika: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands recap — quick follow-up thread for Qs on the org alignment and headcount plan. Short version: targeted role consolidation across ML infra + platform, a temporary hiring reprioritization, and support for folks impacted. Drop questions here and we’ll answer live. (doc: https://go/redwood/reorg-summary)
Maya: timeline note — voluntary transfers window opens tomorrow, formal notices for role changes start in 3 weeks. People Ops will run 1:1s and match volunteers to open slots.
Sam: is there a hiring freeze? curious about outstanding reqs in eng-infra and customer-facing roles.
Diego: not a full freeze. We’re pausing broadly for two product orgs but critical backfills (security, infra, customer SLAs) are green-lit. If you think a req is critical, tag it and Maya/Diego will review.
Rohit: how will this affect IC ladders/promotions? will leveling cycles still happen?
Anika: promotions and leveling reviews continue as planned. We won’t block career growth; we may shift budgets between teams. If you’re mid-promotion, reach out to your manager and People Ops and we’ll prioritize review.
Jules: for teams that are merging, who will own roadmap decisions during the transition? worried about scope creep.
Diego: good question. For merges, a single product lead is appointed for the 8-week transition window. We’ll post ownership matrix by EOD. Short-term: keep tickets scoped, escalate if dependencies surface.
Maya: link to People Ops FAQ + transfer form: https://go/redwood/po-transfers — it has severance policy, relocation, and counseling resources. Confidential hotline in the doc as well.
ellie-bot: Recording of the all-hands and the slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood/all-hands/1905432100 :white_check_mark:
Sam: can we get clarity on on-call and paging changes? those were the main blocker for swapping people between teams.
Priya: on-call rotations will be adjusted but SLA ownership stays with the owning team. If you’re moving teams we’ll overlap rotations for 2 cycles to transfer runbook knowledge.
Rohit: any changes to headcount targets for FY28? numbers were a bit fuzzy in the slides.
Anika: FY28 headcount targets are roughly flat vs the plan announced earlier, with reallocation toward platform, infra, and compliance. Exact numbers will be published in the budget doc next week.
Sam: tagging @Priya — can you set a cross-team sync for infra/product leads? we need to triage open ops hires.
Priya: on it. Will send a Doodle and block a 60m sync tomorrow afternoon. Please add agenda items to the thread.
Anika: thanks all — we’ll run office hours next Wednesday 11–12 PST (Zoom link in calendar). If you need private support, DM Maya or People Ops. Appreciated the constructive Qs — we’ll post follow-ups in the doc. :raising_hand:
